statement.zh: 杰尔万 1933 年发掘的辛那赫里布石砌水道及戈梅尔渠首相关工程见 Jacobsen & Lloyd OIP 24（1935）。「世界第一水道」排名留假说栏。
statement.en: At Jerwan, the 1933 excavation of Sennacherib’s stone aqueduct and related Gomel canal-head work is documented in Jacobsen & Lloyd OIP 24 (1935). “World’s first aqueduct” rankings stay in the hypothesis column.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: aqueduct excavation first.
